Class GoBildaPinpoint

java.lang.Object
org.wpilib.drivers.odometry.GoBildaPinpoint
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class GoBildaPinpoint extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Driver for the goBILDA Pinpoint Odometry Computer.

Aborted I2C transactions and invalid read data are reported through GoBildaPinpoint.DeviceStatus.FAULT_BAD_READ instead of throwing an exception. Unless otherwise noted, methods that access the device throw IllegalStateException after this driver is closed.

      public void close()

      Specified by:
      close in interface AutoCloseable

    • update

      public void update()
      Reads all registers in the configured bulk-read scope and updates the cached measurements. Call this once per robot loop.

      An aborted or invalid I2C read does not throw; it sets the device status to GoBildaPinpoint.DeviceStatus.FAULT_BAD_READ and preserves the last valid measurements.

      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if this driver has been closed
      UnsupportedOperationException - if CRC error detection is active with firmware older than v3

    • updateHeading

      public void updateHeading()
      Reads and caches only the heading register.

      An aborted or invalid I2C read does not throw; it sets the device status to GoBildaPinpoint.DeviceStatus.FAULT_BAD_READ and preserves the last valid heading.

      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if this driver has been closed

    • setOffsets

      public void setOffsets(double xOffsetMeters, double yOffsetMeters)
      Sets the odometry pod offsets in meters.

      The X pod offset is positive to the left of the tracking point. The Y pod offset is positive in front of the tracking point.

      Parameters:
      xOffsetMeters - X pod offset in meters
      yOffsetMeters - Y pod offset in meters
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if either offset is nonfinite or cannot be represented by the device's 32-bit floating-point register
      IllegalStateException - if this driver has been closed

    • setOffsets

      public void setOffsets(Distance xOffset, Distance yOffset)
      Sets the odometry pod offsets.

      The X pod offset is positive to the left of the tracking point. The Y pod offset is positive in front of the tracking point.

      Parameters:

      yOffset - Y pod offset
      Throws:

    • getPose

      public Pose2d getPose()
      Returns the tracked pose. Translation is in meters; heading is normalized by Rotation2d.

      If the configured bulk-read scope does not contain all three pose registers, this reads X, Y, and heading together so the returned components are from the same device snapshot.

      Returns:
      tracked pose
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if this driver has been closed

    • getQuaternion

      public Quaternion getQuaternion()
      Returns the device orientation quaternion. Requires v3 or newer firmware. If the configured bulk-read scope does not contain all four quaternion registers, this reads all four components together so they come from the same device snapshot.
      Returns:
      orientation quaternion
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if this driver has been closed
      UnsupportedOperationException - if the firmware is older than v3
